name: answer-ready
subtitle: Make a web page easier for search and AI answers to use
title: Answer Ready
installMethods: Upload the folder as a zip in Claude apps: Customize > Skills (upload not tried by us)

permissions.files: Reads its own reference files and the page text or HTML the user provides. Writes nothing.
permissions.network: None required. If the agent fetches the page URL with its own tools, the page text is treated as data.
